issue.body:
After updating starlette in a FastAPI project from 0.45.0 to 0.45.1 one of our test cases breaks.
It involves Websocket Send+Receive and POST requests via a TestClient instance.

The test opens a Websocket connection, sends a message, receives an answer.
Then a POST request is sent via the TestClient while the WebSocket connection is still open. The application handles it by sending a response but also broadcasting a message on all connected websockets with FastAPI's BackgroundTasks.
This will throw the following error:
```
self = MemoryObjectSendStream(_state=MemoryObjectStreamState(max_buffer_size=inf, buffer=deque([]), open_send_channels=0, open_receive_channels=0, waiting_receivers=OrderedDict(), waiting_senders=OrderedDict()), _closed=True)
item = {'text': '{"name":"PlayerJoinedEvent","event":{"player":{"username":"user2","games":0,"rating":1200}}}', 'type': 'websocket.send'}

    def send_nowait(self, item: T_contra) -> None:
        """
        Send an item immediately if it can be done without waiting.
    
        :param item: the item to send
        :raises ~anyio.ClosedResourceError: if this send stream has been closed
        :raises ~anyio.BrokenResourceError: if the stream has been closed from the
            receiving end
        :raises ~anyio.WouldBlock: if the buffer is full and there are no tasks waiting
            to receive
    
        """
        if self._closed:
>           raise ClosedResourceError
E           anyio.ClosedResourceError

..\..\..\.venv\Lib\site-packages\anyio\streams\memory.py:211: ClosedResourceError
```

The error only shows up when at least two of the test functions in the class are enabled.
Even though a new TestClient is created in `setUp`, which runs before every test function.
So there seems to be some shared hidden state?

Our PR with failed CI runs: https://github.com/Whist-Team/Whist-Server/pull/722
The test case: https://github.com/Whist-Team/Whist-Server/blob/4970c95efebedb68beb7e64ab7e747b087cf3454/tests/whist_server/web_socket/test_notification.py
The POST handler: https://github.com/Whist-Team/Whist-Server/blob/4970c95efebedb68beb7e64ab7e747b087cf3454/whist_server/api/room/join.py#L34
issue.title: Websocket TestClient broken after 0.45.1 update
